scope: Complete source-only review. The recovery helper was not imported or executed by this reviewer; no worker, test, training, scoring or network operation was run.
findings: Recovery is restricted to the exact previously reviewed postcheck error and four denied nonexistent read-only bytecode probes. All unexpected denials, reference-access mismatches and changed source/input bytes are rejected.
The helper validates saved official v5/test aggregate arithmetic, prediction protocol/split, exactly467 unique IDs and integer candidate choices0..3. It does not recompute predictions or score them.
The original FAILED record and every existing file are preserved and hashed before new exclusive outputs. JSON writes flush and fsync; previous recovery outputs prevent replay.

The lost combined monotonic elapsed is explicitly unavailable/null. Original phase monotonic sums, saved first-to-last UTC interval and STARTED-to-FAILED UTC interval remain distinct and labeled. No missing exact measurement is fabricated.

Exact checkpoint files must have been opened, excluding silent fallback. Actual library observations, sampled task threads, resource size, wheel verification and original successful process chronology are checked.

The helper contains no process invocation, import/execution of peer/model code, train/test evaluation, network or publication. Input arrays and official banks are only streamed for SHA verification, not decoded.
permitted_next_step: Run this exact helper once for recording-only recovery of the existing immutable outputs. Then independently review the generated recovery/completion/timing hashes and contract counts. Do not rerun the original predictor or scorer.
limitations: Source review alone does not mark the actual recovery complete or authorize publication. The original failed postcheck remains evidence; future COMPLETE and any peer Issue require their own actual verification.
